outline:
本課程旨在幫助學生奠定英語基礎，以促進英語聽、說、讀、寫能力之提升，並教導學生自學、自修的方法，提高英語學習的興趣。
Course Description
The aims of the course are primarily to help students improve their reading and
learning processes needed for study in Higher Education at college level, and prepare
students with some basic English skills of reading, listening, speaking and writing.
The course will focus on wide reading.  The reading materials incorporate articles selected from different sources such as the textbook of “Guided Practice for Reading  Comprehension,” English newspapers and magazines, and the like.  The format of the
course will  combine lecture, discussion, and writing, 2 hours per week.  Requirements
include a few quizzes, a mid-term examination and a final examination.
